upstream.name: ECC
upstream.strategy: Use ECC as an optional material warehouse. Adapt selected workflows into Codex-native plugin skills, or install explicitly selected raw/shared ECC material into an ecc-selected plugin.

policy.skills: Prefer Codex-native adaptations in minimal-codex-harness. Raw ECC skills may be installed only when explicitly selected with --with-ecc-skill.
policy.mcp: MCP servers are opt-in and copied disabled by default.
policy.hooks: ECC hooks are stage-only until a Codex-specific adapter is audited.
policy.commands: Convert useful ECC commands into skills or prompts before making them default.

skills.name: agent-harness-construction
skills.reason: Useful if the repo starts designing more Codex plugins, MCP tools, or action surfaces.

skills.name: skill-stocktake
skills.reason: Useful once the local skill catalog grows; adapt from ECC assumptions to Codex/plugin paths.

skills.name: context-budget
skills.reason: Useful for auditing skill/MCP/context bloat; include after Codex-specific wording pass.

skills.name: strategic-compact
skills.reason: Good compaction workflow, but should be adapted without relying on ECC hooks.

skills.name: parallel-execution-optimizer
skills.reason: Potentially useful for large tasks, but should remain explicit because concurrency guidance can be overused.

skills.name: benchmark-optimization-loop
skills.reason: Useful for performance work; include only when an optimization pack is wanted.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.reason: ECC's fuller TDD loop may replace or complement the local tdd-lite skill after review.

skills.name: verification-loop
skills.reason: Candidate for replacing the local verify skill if the ECC version proves better in Codex.

mcp_servers.name: context7
mcp_servers.reason: Useful for library documentation lookup; keep disabled until explicitly selected.

mcp_servers.name: github
mcp_servers.reason: Useful for GitHub-heavy workflows; overlaps with the existing GitHub plugin, so keep opt-in.

mcp_servers.name: playwright
mcp_servers.reason: Useful for browser QA; should be installed only on projects that need UI verification.

mcp_servers.name: exa
mcp_servers.reason: External search can be useful but should stay explicit due authentication/network behavior.

hooks.name: runtime
hooks.reason: Large hook graph with quality, session, and lifecycle automation; stage only until Codex adapter audit.

hooks.name: memory-persistence
hooks.reason: Useful lifecycle concept, but raw ECC implementation is not enabled by default.

commands.name: code-review
commands.reason: Could become a Codex skill or reviewer-agent prompt.

commands.name: security-scan
commands.reason: Could become a focused security skill once the current security-review flow is too broad.

commands.name: test-coverage
commands.reason: Could become a verification sub-skill for repos with coverage tooling.

skip.reason: Domain-specific and not part of a general Codex harness.

skip.group: operator, billing, workspace, and social workflow skills
skip.reason: Operational/business workflows are useful only for specific users, not the default coding harness.
Useful in a separate creative/media pack, not the minimal coding harness.
Too invasive for the default Codex harness.
